topics.title_zh: 苹果秘密组建军团自研自主Agent：硬刚Anthropic与谷歌系统操控权
topics.title_en: Apple Secretly Mobilizes Engineering Force to Build Autonomous OS Agent Against Anthropic and Google
topics.summary_zh: 彭博社与The Verge披露苹果正大规模招募高级工程团队，全速自研能跨应用接管屏幕、自主编写代码与操控浏览器的原生AI代理。此举标志着苹果不再满足于调用第三方模型，正式在底层OS控制权上向Anthropic与谷歌Gemini发起全面正面反击。
topics.summary_en: Bloomberg and The Verge revealed Apple is aggressively hiring senior engineers to develop an autonomous AI agent capable of controlling apps, writing code, and browsing the web. Apple is making a decisive push to seize direct operating-system-level agent control, challenging Anthropic and Google Gemini head-on.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 硬件生态垄断派 / 终端主权论者
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 苹果生态开发者与硬件架构分析师
perspective_pro.point_zh: 苹果手握全球数十亿高净值终端与底层系统权限，原生级端侧执行具备绝对隐私安全与零延迟优势，第三方云端代理在系统级交互面前将沦为脆弱的空中楼阁。
perspective_pro.point_en: With billions of devices and native OS-level privileges, Apple can deliver unmatched on-device privacy and low latency, reducing third-party cloud agents to fragile wrappers.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 大模型敏捷派 / 算力基因怀疑派
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 前沿基座模型研究员与硅谷AI投资人
perspective_con.speaker_en: Frontier AI Researchers & Silicon Valley Investors
perspective_con.point_zh: 苹果基座大模型与推理能力已被一线梯队甩开代差。Agent极度依赖复杂的反思与容错推理，缺乏顶尖模型基因的苹果盲目自研，极可能重蹈Siri迟钝与高误操率覆辙。
perspective_con.point_en: Apple's foundation reasoning models lag generations behind. Building autonomous agents requires cutting-edge self-correction; rushing into native agents risks creating another erratic Siri.

linked_tweets.content_zh: 最新报道：据报道，苹果公司正在开发一种人工智能代理，可以控制设备、浏览网页和代表用户编写代码。

linked_tweets.author: Mark Gurman
linked_tweets.content_zh: 苹果自己的职位清单阐明了这一雄心：一个人工智能代理，可以像人一样使用计算机，在浏览器、应用程序、终端和服务之间移动，编写和调试代码，并决定使用哪些工具来完成任务。这远远超出了今天的 Siri。
linked_tweets.content_en: Apple’s own job listing spells out the ambition: An AI agent that can use a computer like a person, moving between browsers, apps, terminals and services, writing and debugging code, and deciding which tools to use to complete a task. This is far beyond today’s Siri.

topics.title_en: Anthropic Debuts at $1.5T Nasdaq Record as Token Prices Tumble 21% Amid Commoditization
topics.summary_zh: Anthropic以高达1.5万亿美元估值震撼登陆纳斯达克，助推Iconiq资本斩获超430%暴利；然而Ramp与OpenRouter最新行业数据却显示，大模型Token单价在短短六周内骤降21.2%，高估值神话正遭受模型工业级商品化与企业端支出放缓的严峻审判。
topics.summary_en: Anthropic shocked Wall Street by listing on Nasdaq at a record $1.5 trillion valuation, netting Iconiq Capital over a 430% return. However, fresh data shows model token prices plunged 21.2% in just six weeks, putting sky-high valuations at risk as model commoditization accelerates.

topics.title_zh: 谷歌Gemini全面接管Mac系统桌面，秘密“镜像维度”沙盒难消安全恐慌
topics.title_en: Google Gemini Grants Itself Full Mac Control Backed by Secret 'Mirror Dimension' Sandbox
topics.summary_zh: 谷歌正式为macOS版Gemini开放跨应用自主操控电脑权限，并披露其正通过代号“镜像维度”的虚拟仿真网络环境测试AI智能体。然而与此同时，美国大型银行集体向储户发出免责通牒，明确声明AI代理操作失误造成的财产损失须由用户自行承担，引发巨大信任危机。
topics.summary_en: Google released a Mac feature allowing Gemini to autonomously operate desktop applications, backed by an isolated 'Mirror Dimension' simulated web environment for agent hardening. Simultaneously, major US banks warned customers that they are solely liable for AI agent financial blunders.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 自动化效能派 / 端侧智能拓荒者
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 谷歌Chrome系统团队与跨平台效能极客
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Google Chrome Team & Desktop Automation Geeks
perspective_pro.point_zh: 代行人类点击与跨软件调度是智能体的终极形态。通过镜像维度进行上亿次对抗加固，Gemini成功跨越了聊天玩具与生产力利器的鸿沟，大幅释放真实人机协作效率。
perspective_pro.point_en: Operating desktop apps natively is the holy grail of agentic productivity. Hardened through the isolated 'Mirror Dimension', Gemini bridges the gap from chatbot to an autonomous digital coworker.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 网络风控派 / 数字主权防御者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 金融合规安全主管与红队渗透专家
perspective_con.speaker_en: Financial Security Officers & Red Team Researchers
perspective_con.point_zh: 给AI开放系统指针与凭据无异于门户大开，提示词注入防不胜防。华尔街金融机构的甩责声明已敲响警钟：厂商在沙盒里自嗨，真正承担越权删库与财务灾难的却是终端用户。
perspective_con.point_en: Granting an agent direct OS credentials invites catastrophic prompt injection. Banks disclaiming liability prove the harsh reality: users are bearing the full fallout of reckless agent deployment.

linked_tweets.author: International Cyber Digest
linked_tweets.content_zh:
️美国主要银行告诉客户，当他们的人工智能代理在他们的钱上犯错时，他们就会陷入困境。

Ally 的条款称，客户“对人工智能采取的任何行动负责”。

从 11 月 24 日起，富国银行将要求客户对代理人的行为承担责任，即使他们要求代理人停止，除非他们能够证明他们撤销了代理人的访问权限。

埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 对他的 Grok Bot 代理做出了相反的承诺：如果出现问题，“我们会让你变得完整。” Grok 自己的条款仍然要求用户负责。
linked_tweets.content_en:
‼️ Major US banks are telling customers that when their AI agent makes a mistake with their money, they're on the hook.

Ally's terms say customers are "responsible for any actions that the AI takes."

From 24 November, Wells Fargo will hold customers liable for what an agent does even after they tell it to stop, unless they can prove they revoked its access.

Elon Musk promises the opposite for his Grok Bot agent: if it messes up, "we will make you whole." Grok's own terms still make users responsible.
